fusions.name: Heeler's Nip
fusions.desc: A nip at the heels of an enemy up to 2.5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Stampede Drive
fusions.desc: Drives through a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Yoked Together
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Tithe of the Herd
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
